alt: Four numbered panels explain a legacy balance check, the addition of unlimited entitlement, the actual client upload-check failure, and the later model. There are no arrows between panels. In panel 3, the server excludes the unlimited group from a finite-credit sum; the client compares zero with thirty-eight while ignoring a separate unlimited signal, then rejects before POST. In panel 4, the same uncapped group feeds an admission decision that admits and a separate display projection that returns an unlimited sentinel. The display value is not an admission input.
